0.9.128.title: Harbor Beta 0.9.128
0.9.128.intro: The biggest beta yet: a full Sports section, a complete DJ deck, a much larger Music experience, a rebuilt Manga library with a phone remote, and a curated film canon running through discovery and detail pages, alongside a deep pass on speed, caching and reliability.

sections.heading: Sports
items: Added a full Sports section with live scores, schedules, event pages, league guides, standings and date navigation.
Added athlete profiles with career history, portraits, videos and identity matching across providers.
Added boxing schedules and fight cards, baseball, American football, motorsport, NASCAR and racing venues.
Added esports coverage with match rails, team directories, profiles, rankings, team history and map blueprints.
Added sports broadcasts with an addon source panel, stream picker, watch providers and an access gate.
Added event enrichment with boxscores, venue lineups, score detail, odds and competition metadata.
Added reminders for matches you follow, personalization, and regional coverage including Saudi league team aliases.
Added the full Sports experience to Big Picture, with its own hero, event rows, broadcast stage, chips and explore view.
A fast league now renders before a slow one instead of everything waiting for the slowest, and cached scores survive a provider outage.
A missing score stays missing and a reported zero stays zero, so old timestamps can no longer manufacture a fake live game.
One busy league can no longer crowd F1, the NBA and fight nights out of discovery, and a single fight card counts as one highlight.
Fights with unannounced opponents now show the named event rather than inventing participants.
Provider demonstration data can no longer populate a real roster or schedule, and rosters keep provider identity while de-duplicating athletes.
Stale or unrelated live race data can no longer overwrite the race you selected, and NASCAR venue matching no longer confuses similarly named cities.

sections.heading: DJ deck
items: Added a standalone DJ deck window with two decks, platter scratching with real physics, tempo sync and crossfade.
Added performance pads with several pad modes, loop controls, and an FX rack with a dedicated FX bay.
Added a live waveform display with tile-based painting, DSP analysis and motion.
Added deck audio routing, release effects and sample playback.
A deck that is not live is never adopted, so controls cannot act on the wrong deck.
A disabled equaliser no longer ships its curve, while speed changes still apply.

sections.heading: Music
items: Added Listen Together so a mix can be followed live between windows.
Added a Hatsune Miku visualizer that dances, changes expression and reacts to rhythm and tempo.
Added an animated GIF visualizer with its own decoder and settings.
Added virtual audio cable output with PulseAudio, PipeWire and CoreAudio backends for broadcasting Harbor audio.
Added artist pages with galleries, rarities, linked biographies, related artists and a performance spotlight.
Added genre browsing with per-genre catalogs, scenes, insights, videos and a full set of genre artwork.
Added record label pages with label metadata and roster.
Added Billboard and Rolling Stone chart pages and rows.
Added karaoke, synced lyrics and a lyric offset control.
Added a parametric equalizer, audio metering and expanded audio settings.
Added speaker and cast output for music, plus music downloads.
Added daily mixes, made for you rows, recently played contexts and top playlists.
Added Discord Rich Presence for music.
Added playlist cover editing, artwork saving and queue continuation between sessions.
Improved music search with better ranking, scoring, multiple search lanes and fallbacks.
Two different artists who share a name no longer merge into one, and neither inherits the other's audience.
A well-known artist can no longer ride an unrelated query to the top of results, and a Cyrillic typo no longer hands the top spot to an impostor.
A song liked from a playlist still reads as liked when it plays from a different source.
The player title now sends you back to the playlist the song is actually playing from.
A song with a release tag in its title no longer loses its exact match, and titles that are only noise keep their raw form instead of vanishing.
Up next renders nothing at all when there is no next track, instead of a bare heading.
A blank lyric line now shows nothing rather than an empty scrim, and a song with no lyrics shows no overlay.
Lossy codecs such as Opus no longer inherit Hi-Res or decoder depth from a high sample rate.
A queued track keeps its place in the queue instead of being pushed to the end.

sections.heading: Manga
items: Rebuilt the Manga library with a spotlight, a home-style favorites rail, grid favorites, a section switcher and scroll-spy. — @Thunderhawkk
Added a phone remote with QR pairing, control layouts, a two-way reader settings sheet and a scroll-following strip mode. — @Thunderhawkk
Mirrored desktop reading modes on mobile and synced modes and positions in both directions. — @Thunderhawkk
Added pinch zoom, a zoom badge, a direction toggle and tap to toggle chrome in the phone reader. — @Thunderhawkk
Separated manga lists from shared lists so they have their own quota. — @Thunderhawkk
Added in-app context menus, read badges on finished chapters, and continue reading that advances only on true completion. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed continue reading not restoring the last chapter position, and details not resuming from loaded chapters. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed strip follow jitter, right-to-left drift, loading collapse, short-page centering and the paged chrome toggle. — @Thunderhawkk
Made favorites, chapters and sections load lazily so large libraries scroll far more smoothly. — @Thunderhawkk

sections.heading: Discovery and detail pages
items: Added curated film lists including the National Film Registry, AFI 100, Sight and Sound, the Criterion Collection and major festival winners, with accolade badges on cards.
Added country browsing with per-country canons, notable people and tiles, plus a Born Today row.
Added a criticism panel, production facts, camera and format details, adaptation rows and soundtrack rows to detail pages.
Added filmography grouping and completion tracking, and a shared crew line between two people.
Added a relationship graph that explains why titles are connected.
A festival badge now names the prize it won rather than leaning on the curator line.
Title matching is stricter, so a sequel marker or a colon continuation no longer passes as the same film, and short common-word titles are treated as risky.

sections.heading: Speed and efficiency
items: Watchlist grids are virtualized per date group, so very large watchlists scroll smoothly. — @Thunderhawkk
Proxied images are resized on the server with a thumbnail cache, and cover thumbnails are kept on disk and can be cleared by hand. — @Thunderhawkk
Requests for the same thing are now shared instead of duplicated, and a prefetch skips anything already resolved or already being fetched.
Closing a page now cancels the work it started, and a late reply from cancelled work can no longer populate a cache or resurrect a stopped session.
Feeds render progressively as each source answers, rather than holding everything for the slowest.
Caches are now size-bounded with real expiry, so stale, future-dated or malformed entries cannot hide fresh data.
A slow provider now hits its deadline without discarding the data that already arrived.
Artwork downloads stop at a size limit without relying on the server reporting a length, and an unmeasured poster is no longer downgraded.
Live TV responses are bounded and cancellable, so a slow or endless source can no longer hang the page.

sections.heading: Plugins and extensions
items: Fixed extension archives being fetched as text instead of bytes, which corrupted every download. — @Thunderhawkk
Added the extension API members measured as missing, plus CloudflareKiller and several Android system stubs, so far more extensions load. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed V-Cloud, Pixeldrain and Supervideo link resolution. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed the compatibility layer failing to build from folder paths containing spaces. — @Thunderhawkk
Gave plugin checks the same timeout as playback and warmed the bridge before a deadline starts. — @Thunderhawkk
An addon outage is now told apart from a cancelled request and from a real error, so a healthy source is not marked broken.

sections.heading: Interface and navigation
items: Added in-place sidebar editing with hide, reorder and a hidden tray, replacing the separate Manga and Live TV hide toggles. — @Thunderhawkk
Added the MinUI Dark theme preset with a token-driven dock. — @Thunderhawkk
Added per-cache storage usage in the Caches tab so you can see what is using space. — @Thunderhawkk
Kept sidebar menus measurable and immediately dismissible. — @Talal1011
Fixed rows not re-measuring cards after switching card style. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed TV cards using blurred posters instead of real anime backdrops. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed poster dock clipping at row boundaries and header action overlap. — @O1Abdulrahman
Fixed stray focus rings in search and made Tab stay inside the overlay. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed F6 tearing down pane focus, and focus restore borrowing page-level rounded corners. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed the clock overlay being hidden in windowed mode.
A fractional interface zoom no longer lifts the dock off the bottom of the window.
Pages no longer scroll past the end of the list they belong to, and a zoomed or panned view now counts its own offset instead of pushing content upward.
Hover and keyboard controls now meet a 44 pixel pointer target and reveal on focus as well as hover.

sections.heading: Playback and platform
items: Fixed a Linux race by creating the mpv render context before loading the file. — @kalashnikxvxiii
Native power inhibition is now preferred on Cinnamon and GNOME, so the screen no longer sleeps during playback. — @anmol210202
Fixed watchlist same-name collisions, duplicate ghost entries and anime details hijacking the wrong title. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed metadata addons installed through a Stremio account not being detected. — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed the cache clear confirmation resetting before the clear ran. — @AnessBen
Improved HDR session handling and the overlay stage across providers.
Windows playback now serializes start and stop separately from property polling, so a quick stop and start no longer trips over itself.
DRM, local tracks and unsupported cast protocols no longer trigger native playback on a receiver.
Cancelling a cast load no longer mutes or plays the local picture before the stop is acknowledged.
Cancelling a download now removes the partial file and its entry instead of leaving a stub behind.
A provider key that hits a quota error is treated as a failure, while an entitlement error no longer rejects the key everywhere.

sections.heading: Mobile and TV
items: We are still working on mobile and TV apps. We have no ETA but we appreciate and value all feedback given for the circulating TV betas.

0.9.127.title: Harbor Beta 0.9.127
0.9.127.intro: A focused update for Windows HDR playback, window startup, and embedded subtitle selection.

sections.heading: What's in this one
items: Fixed the extra Harbor loading window during True HDR embedded playback on Windows.
Fixed the thin light line at the bottom of Harbor when reopening maximized with Windows taskbar auto-hide enabled.
Fixed automatic embedded subtitle selection when track information arrives late. With Prefer embedded subtitles enabled, matching embedded tracks take priority over external results.

sections.heading: A note from Talal
items: Thank you for the reports and for testing these fixes. Please check HDR playback, reopening Harbor maximized, and automatic subtitle selection on your setup. If an issue returns, include your version, Windows display settings, and clear steps in our Discord support channel. Hide private links and account details before sharing. — Talal

0.9.126.title: Harbor Beta 0.9.126
0.9.126.intro: Account, playback, subtitle, and browsing improvements, with more reliable name saving and session handling.

sections.heading: Accounts and sessions
items: Improved Harbor display-name saving, retry handling, and account isolation.

Added proactive Harbor session renewal and a single retry for eligible requests after an expired session. Temporary connection failures preserve your saved session; revoked sessions still require sign-in.

sections.heading: Playback and subtitles
items: Fixed the Windows player startup background and cleanup of Harbor's RTX filter when switching between eligible SDR and HDR sources.
Fixed subtitle text remaining visible after selecting Off, including late subtitle events.
Included seeking, Windows audio recovery, and content-advisory updates.

Load custom mpv scripts before player initialization and open the separate Windows player on Harbor's display (#1422). HDR display restoration still needs device-specific verification, especially in separate-window mode.
Improved subtitle pop-out placement and prevented duplicate subtitle overlays while it is open.
Improved playback statistics: unavailable drop counters no longer appear as a measured zero. This is not a universal fix for fullscreen stuttering.

sections.heading: Browsing and retained changes
items: Improved Discover loading and scrolling behavior.
Updated settings layouts and profile-background previews, and added the subtitle-FPS icon to the icon collection.
Added custom screensaver videos, GIFs and images, richer Voyage hover details, and corrected settings-search destinations.
Improved anime Continue Watching deduplication and Bleach TYBW episode labels. Added offline retry queues for Trakt and Simkl progress, isolated by Harbor profile (#1421).
Retained the approved Continue Watching and plugin updates, along with earlier beta and experimental fixes.
These version-specific release notes remain available offline after installation.

sections.heading: Request security
items: Improved provider domain checks, including public suffixes and shared hosting domains.

sections.heading: Please test
items: Save a display name, reopen settings, and restart Harbor. Confirm the saved name and sign-in remain.
Check a failed save while offline, then reconnect and retry. A failed save must not report success.
Check account actions after real session renewal without signing in again. Offline recovery and expiry retry have passed simulated tests; live verification is still pending.
Turn subtitles Off while a line is visible, seek, then turn them on again. Check that no old line stays on screen.
On Windows, switch from SDR playback with RTX enabled to HDR and back. Check the picture, seeking, audio, and fullscreen.
Finish an episode offline, reconnect, and check tracker history. Switch profiles and confirm pending progress does not move to the other profile.
Check custom screensaver playback, subtitle pop-out open/close, settings search, and separate-window placement on a second monitor.
Report problems through Harbor's official Discord support. Include your version, platform, steps, and expected result. Remove passwords, tokens, and private URLs from anything you share.

sections.heading: A note from Talal
items: Thank you for helping improve Harbor. Please try the features you use every day and tell us if anything feels different. If something goes wrong, note what you were doing, your Harbor version, and your operating system. For playback issues, include whether HDR, RTX, or fullscreen was enabled. Clear steps and a short recording help us investigate. Please hide passwords, tokens, and private links before sharing. — Talal

0.9.125.title: Harbor Beta 0.9.125
0.9.125.intro: Playback, subtitles, Continue Watching, navigation, and library improvements brought forward from Experimental 0.0.3 and 0.0.4, together with the latest approved beta changes.

sections.heading: Playback, subtitles, and X-Ray
items: Fixed Arabic/English subtitle identity and grouping, and preserved manual Live Try timing through seeking and pause/resume.
Improved encrypted HLS playback to address repeated segment stalls (#1400).
Improved Windows audio-output switching and recovery (#1334), and restored window bounds and maximized state after leaving fullscreen (#1394).
Select an X-Ray actor to browse their movies and TV shows without leaving the player.
Added Linux MPRIS desktop media controls for playback, seeking, volume, and metadata (#1372).

sections.heading: Continue Watching and your library
items: Dismissed cards can return when you make further progress, including progress from Trakt and Simkl. Improved external-source refresh and retained shared-profile safeguards (#1411, #1359).
Added optional episode-still artwork for Continue Watching, with your saved frame as a fallback. This preference is off by default (#1411).
Season selection follows watch progress (#1401).
Added drag-and-drop list reordering (#1361) and descriptions for custom and featured lists (#1371).

sections.heading: Navigation and appearance
items: Improved TV/controller navigation across settings, settings focus, and home search (#1408).
Improved Arabic/RTL navigation in Big Picture, the poster dock, and live TV multiview (#1406).
Restored the standard row arrows while retaining navigation fixes. Liquid Glass arrows are unchanged.
Restored ElegantFin sidebar collapse and Back alignment (#1399).
Refreshed the content advisory popup with translucent styling and updated animations. Removed the migration that automatically enabled content advisories.
Updated studio/network facts: removed average-rating/runtime facts and display an IMDb score for the featured acclaimed title when available.
Added a custom background and dimming control for the Who's watching screen.

sections.heading: Books, manga, and more
items: Added full Edge TTS voice discovery for ebooks (#1409).
Included manga downloads, browsing/extension improvements, and AniList/MAL progress tracking (#1385).
Included desktop notifications (#1398) and controller cursor toggle, idle auto-hide, and input-yield options (#1362).
Experimental release notes remain available after installation, including offline. Beta 0.9.125 includes its own bundled changelog fallback.
Updated regression coverage for navigation, subtitles, release notes, Continue Watching, and background controls.

sections.heading: Account changes
items: Discord account sign-in, linking, and recovery have been removed. Discord Rich Presence is separate and remains available.

sections.heading: A note from Talal
items: Sorry for the delay, everyone, and thank you for your patience. The stable release will be published soon. Thank you to every tester, developer, and contributor helping us improve Harbor.

sections.heading: Credits
items: Credits: Thunderhawkk, uddx7, O1Abdulrahman, anmol210202, pengunnn, OwaisByte, kalashnikxvxiii, Talal1011, and the Harbor contributors.

0.9.121.title: Harbor Beta 0.9.121
0.9.121.intro: A major beta with a complete eBook experience, Plex/Jellyfin/Emby playback, a new Windows installer, full interface localization, and substantial subtitle and playback reliability work.

sections.heading: Installer and updates
items: Added Harbor's new Windows installer and updater handoff, with a verified embedded app payload, per-user installation, automatic relaunch, and an installation marker for future updates — J
Kept the existing NSIS updater path available so installations made with older Harbor installers continue receiving updates — J
Added a dedicated Harbor uninstaller and a localized installer experience in English, Arabic, Portuguese, and Russian — J
Added release safeguards that reject missing, oversized, stale, or mismatched installer payloads before a manifest entry can be generated — J

sections.heading: eBooks
items: Added a complete eBook home and discovery experience with featured books, popular and genre shelves, recommendations, collections, awards, search, filters, and incremental loading — @capex122
Added rich book details with authors, ratings, publication data, series relationships, chapter lists, and Manga, anime, or live-action adaptation links — @capex122

Added Harbor reading mode and an optional animated book mode with chapter navigation, progress, bookmarks, annotations, search, line tracking, themes, typography, direction, and custom fonts — @capex122
Added local EPUB and folder support, Harbor eBook plugins, source matching, chapter caching, offline export, and Downloads integration — @capex122
Added opt-in DeepSeek chapter translation with cached translations and original-text restoration — @capex122
Added Edge TTS narration with language-grouped voices, samples, generation progress, cancellation, seeking, and synchronized line tracking — @capex122
Added optional New York Times bestseller lists to the eBook home when an NYT Books API key is configured — J

sections.heading: Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, and local media
items: Added first-class Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby connections with discovery, health checks, library synchronization, playback, and progress updates — @Jazzmedo
Added a unified version picker for local files, home-server copies, and online streams, including source preference controls and Continue Watching integration — @Jazzmedo
Added support for consecutive dual-episode files such as S01E01E02 and S01E01-02, with shared availability, resume, completion, and next-episode behavior — @Jazzmedo
Expanded local-library folder management, scanning, identification, availability details, backup restoration, and logical episode counting — @Jazzmedo
Local subtitle sidecars now attach after playback loads, including sidecars whose filename is not an exact match for the video — @Jazzmedo
Added local and home-server versions throughout Big Picture, mobile, remote-control, detail, library, and playback surfaces — @Jazzmedo

sections.heading: Subtitles and Live Sync
items: Subtitle discovery now returns results progressively, responds faster, and can populate up to 15 valid candidates from configured sources — @Talal1011
Removed the unrelated-language fallback from automatic subtitle selection so Harbor waits for the user's preferred language instead of silently choosing the wrong one — @Talal1011
Improved Arabic subtitle decoding, normalization, quality scoring, and ranking across mixed encodings and provider metadata — @Talal1011
Improved release matching with episode, cut, source, resolution, release-group, hearing-impaired, foreign-only, and machine-translation evidence — @Talal1011
SubDL and SubSource can participate in advanced matching through credentials stored in Harbor settings without exposing provider secrets to web content — @Talal1011
Provider subtitle downloads now enforce public HTTP(S) addresses and keep trusted local or generated subtitle paths separate from provider-derived URLs — @Talal1011
The latest manually selected external subtitle is cached by content and release, then restored immediately when the same movie or episode is reopened — @Talal1011
Saved Live Sync corrections now remain attached to the selected release, restore without a second provider request, and avoid applying the baked timing offset twice — @Talal1011

Added conservative experimental cross-language subtitle matching with independent evidence, held-out validation, monotonic alignment, and offer-only safety gates when confidence is incomplete — @Talal1011
Restored the subtitle menu resize control and preserved the Find more subtitles, FPS, style, and timing controls across desktop and Big Picture — @Talal1011 and @3laa-NA

sections.heading: Playback and source reliability
items: Holding the primary left mouse button over a playing video now temporarily uses 2× speed, restores the previous rate on release, and does not accidentally pause playback — @theabdull5h
Harbor TMDB search results now query both bare and type-scoped TMDB IDs so compatible stream and metadata addons return their sources — @Thunderhawkk
The player now starts from the saved volume and mute preference instead of briefly exposing the default volume before the playback engine responds — @Thunderhawkk
Fixed direct HTTPS addon links being mistaken for playable direct streams and hiding P2P results while source mode was set to Addons — @Talal1011
Source mode now consistently supports Both, Direct/debrid, and P2P preferences across the picker, player switcher, filters, and Big Picture — @Talal1011
Downloaded local files now show as fully Cached immediately instead of displaying a growing network-buffer bar — @uddx7
Improved native trailer playback by preferring progressive files at lower qualities, retrying adaptive video/audio merges, and finding bundled ffmpeg on Intel and Apple Silicon Macs — @pengunnn
Normalized parsed audio channel counts and bit depth when addon metadata supplies arrays, strings, or malformed values — J
Returned content advisory to Harbor's restrained player design while retaining the current guidance, settings, and reliability fixes — @Talal1011 and @O1Abdulrahman

sections.heading: Continue Watching, Simkl, and addons
items: Continue Watching artwork now honors the configured metadata addon and safely falls back when that addon has no artwork — @Thunderhawkk
Rewatching a completed movie while signed out of Stremio now returns it to Continue Watching after meaningful playback — @Thunderhawkk
Simkl completion and source-switch scrobbles now use a teardown-safe path with watched-history recovery so finished titles do not remain stuck as currently watching — @Thunderhawkk
Updating an addon now replaces it in place, removes duplicates, and preserves its position in both Harbor and the synchronized Stremio collection — @Thunderhawkk

sections.heading: Profiles, themes, calendar, and controls
items: Primary-profile imports now show Merge or Replace choices for overlapping watchlist, favorites, and selected addon data, with non-destructive Merge as the default — @Thunderhawkk
Theme creator names are clickable and keyboard-accessible across Community Store surfaces, open the current creator profile, and no longer trigger the theme card underneath — @uddx7
Added behavior-based Community Store theme filters with viewport-aware, scrollable menus — @pengunnn
Friend presence now stays consistent between the friends panel and profile hover card — @pengunnn
Added the Kawaii beta theme and refined its profile picker, hero artwork fallback, and navigation presentation — J
Calendar items now show local release times and live countdowns, with an optional larger-poster layout and sharper portrait artwork — @uddx7
Fixed the macOS window opening beneath the menu bar, camera notch, or Dock by fitting it to the visible screen area — @3-pr
Custom theme app icons now update the Harbor icon shown in the macOS Dock — @3-pr
Fixed Home hero actions remaining unresponsive after a drag and fixed the right-click Add to my list submenu being clipped — @uddx7
Expanded controller navigation, glyphs, cursor behavior, device presentation, and player-control handling — J
Refined Live TV guide navigation, EPG matching, lazy rendering, program presentation, and drag panning — J

sections.heading: Languages and accessibility
items: Added complete interface localization for Arabic, Chinese, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, and Vietnamese — @xjl9
Language changes now apply at runtime with RTL layout, regional defaults, locale-aware plurals, and localized product, player, settings, eBook, Manga, profile, search, and error text — @xjl9
Completed translations for the new profile-import, stream-mode, subtitle-classification, cross-language matching, and New York Times eBook controls — @xjl9 and @Talal1011

0.9.120.title: Harbor Beta 0.9.120
0.9.120.intro: A focused macOS compatibility hotfix for the 0.9.119 beta.

sections.heading: macOS compatibility
items: Fixed the launch crash on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs by bundling libmpv and its required dynamic libraries inside Harbor — @Talal1011
Added release-build validation that rejects macOS artifacts containing missing or machine-local Homebrew library references — @Talal1011

0.9.119.title: Harbor Beta 0.9.119
0.9.119.intro: A large reliability and workflow update focused on playback, P2P downloads, subtitles, profiles, anime, Manga, Live TV, controller support, and safer external links. Every entry credits the contributor responsible for the work.

sections.heading: Playback and source handling
items: Faster and more reliable preparation for debrid and direct sources while preserving provider fallback and URL validation — @Talal1011
Improved startup and source switching for large 4K Blu-ray remux sources — @Talal1011
The loading screen now follows the real first video frame and no longer flashes a frame from the previous title — @Talal1011
Improved recovery from black screens, failed sources, app focus changes, and paused or resumed playback — @Talal1011
Pause state is preserved across seek restarts, with keyframe seeking used for normal seek actions — @Talal1011
Continue Watching and next-episode playback keep the selected source when it remains compatible — @Talal1011
Streams that end prematurely retry the same source once before Harbor tries another candidate — @Thunderhawkk
Added an optional player interaction lock with a setting and configurable hotkey — @Talal1011
Locked playback now blocks player input, while inactive lock controls disappear automatically — @Talal1011
Player overlays remain independent when menus such as the subtitle panel are moved or resized — @Talal1011
Provider-specific errors retain Retry and Choose another source actions — @Talal1011
The top-right player window control now respects the selected fullscreen or maximize preference — @OwaisByte
Linux trailer playback now supports reliable loading, seeking, and compatible download formats — @pengunnn
Fullscreen playback now has the correct context-menu behavior — @Auramist
Skip Intro and Skip Outro pills now show an animated countdown that pauses while hovered — @O1Abdulrahman

sections.heading: P2P streaming and downloads
items: Playback, intentional downloads, and background streaming now have explicit torrent ownership — @Talal1011
Abandoned stream torrents are cleaned up after cancellation, failed connection, source switching, or player exit — @Talal1011
Cancelled stream jobs no longer silently resume from stale persisted sessions after Harbor restarts — @Talal1011
Streaming and downloading the same torrent reuse one local-engine job instead of creating duplicate data — @Talal1011
Completed intentional downloads can be reused when the same source is selected for playback — @Talal1011
Downloaded data remains available until its final intentional owner is cancelled — @Talal1011
Improved season-pack file selection and recovery from stalled Preparing or Connecting states — @Talal1011
Improved retry and cleanup behavior when a P2P source has no usable peers — @Talal1011
Local-engine activity reporting and pause, resume, cancel, clear, and restart controls are more reliable — @Talal1011

sections.heading: Subtitles
items: Automatic subtitle discovery keeps searching configured Stremio addons and Harbor providers instead of stopping after the first fallback track — @Talal1011
Automatic subtitle selection follows preferred languages while Find more subtitles still exposes the complete manual search — @Talal1011
Subtitle discovery is prioritized ahead of optional content-advisory work — @Talal1011
Prevented foreign embedded subtitles from flashing before preferred-language selection completes — @Talal1011
Improved provider labels, upstream source names, release names, numbering, author information, download metadata, and subtitle details — @Talal1011
Added native subtitle source-FPS controls with safer transition boundaries — @OwaisByte
External subtitles are ranked using release group, episode, edition, source family, resolution, and other real release evidence — @Talal1011
Generic addon names and video-derived fallback titles no longer create repeated or misleading compatibility scores — @Talal1011
Better match now requires strong release evidence and no longer promotes embedded tracks as the downloadable best match — @Talal1011
Selected subtitles are remembered for the same content and release, restored after temporary embedded fallback, and not reused after incompatible torrent or hash changes — @Talal1011
Improved SubDL and Subsource limits, result handling, rate-limit behavior, and manual addition — @Talal1011
Right-click Paste now correctly saves SubDL and Subsource API keys — @uddx7
Subtitle offset feedback and manual timing controls remain available alongside FPS correction — @Talal1011 and @OwaisByte
The subtitle menu is movable, independently resizable, and supports long-title handling — @Talal1011
Subtitle results have a keyboard-accessible details view with a Back action — @Talal1011
Live Sync provides simpler whole-track alignment, drift correction, and section correction controls — @Talal1011
Saved Live Sync corrections persist, keep the corrected track selected, and are restored for the same release — @Talal1011
Anime subtitle lookup now distinguishes long-running absolute numbering from seasonal TVDB numbering — @comet776

sections.heading: X-Ray and content advisory
items: X-Ray recognition work is moved away from the main interface path for more responsive cast detection — @Talal1011
Recognition cadence, image work, caches, and cleanup are bounded to reduce CPU and memory growth — @Talal1011
Packaged-app compatibility was improved without weakening Harbor's required security policy — @Talal1011
X-Ray resources are released when the overlay or player closes, with a clear memory-usage notice in settings — @Talal1011
Updated X-Ray cast presentation inside the player — @Talal1011
Content advisory now uses Common Sense Media age guidance and four clear severity categories — @O1Abdulrahman
Content advisory supports colored and monochrome presentation styles with a refined player layout — @O1Abdulrahman and @Talal1011

sections.heading: Profiles, accounts, library, and recovery
items: Discord can now be used for sign-up, sign-in, account linking, unlinking, and account recovery — @uddx7
Linked Discord accounts can join the Harbor server and receive recovery PINs through Discord — @uddx7
Improved Discord OAuth cancellation, listener restart, stale-state cleanup, and error handling — @uddx7
Sessions, addon keys, watched state, progress, library synchronization, and recovery data are isolated per Harbor profile — @Thunderhawkk
Addons and catalogs refresh correctly after switching profiles — @Thunderhawkk
Stale addon deep links no longer replay on a later launch — @Thunderhawkk
Custom profile backgrounds are stored independently for each profile — @uddx7 (omar)
Backup exports can include only selected sections, and restored service sign-ins are remapped safely to the active profile — @Thunderhawkk

items: External links across profiles, groups, BBCode, and Community Store comments now use one app-wide confirmation — @OwaisByte
